item.title: v0.2.1
item.description:
v0.2.1

Fixed

  • Sparkle update dialog now respects in-app language setting
  • 10 hardcoded English strings localized (Picker labels, ETA, ffmpeg prompt, folder button)
  • DownloadQueue force unwrap eliminated in processItem
  • Debug prints removed from notification permission request

item.title: v0.2.0
item.description:
v0.2.0

Added

  • Video thumbnails with duration badge in queue and subscriptions
  • Format filtering by resolution, codec, and file size
  • Cookies setup guide popover in Settings
  • Privacy info popover in About section

Changed

  • Minimum macOS requirement raised to macOS 14
  • Cookies path redaction now covers --cookies=path form
  • Add-to-queue errors are now surfaced to the user

Fixed

  • Swift 6 strict concurrency errors with NSImage
  • onChange deprecation warnings on macOS 14

item.title: v0.1.5
item.description:
v0.1.5

Added

  • Channel subscription monitoring — subscribe to YouTube channels and get macOS notifications for new uploads
  • Unified Settings tab view
  • Subscription unit tests (FeedXMLParser, ChannelSubscriptionStore)

Changed

  • Concurrent RSS feed polling via TaskGroup
  • Batch disk writes for subscription updates
  • Poll interval persisted to UserDefaults

Fixed

  • Crash on invalid subscription URL
  • Timer leak in SubscriptionPollingManager deinit
  • Swift 6 strict concurrency compilation errors
